vxm_service.conditions: One task allocation from the central VXM, not replicated per hemisphere. Rates share one budget and cannot be added. Compute occupancy only: no transfers, reduction, dependency scheduling or special-function startup latency. FP32 denotes operand format, not correctly rounded exp/rsqrt accuracy. Only INT32 add is consumed by current GEMM; other operations are standalone services.

core.organization: disjoint N shards; no inter-Macro N reduction

cluster_domain.reduction: same N shard across SuperLanes; no reduction across Cluster domains

macros_per_core.conditions: Four Macros per Core implement N shards; INT8 Core has K=16,N=128,256 MAC/cycle.

cores_per_cluster.conditions: Five Cores per Cluster slice in one SuperLane. One task across20SL has K=320,N=640; 20SL extend K and do not multiply N.

clusters_per_superlane.conditions: Four independent Cluster task domains in each SuperLane of each Plane.

superlanes_per_plane.conditions: 20 SuperLanes per Plane, chained along K. One Plane has400Cores/1600Macros.

planes_per_hemisphere.conditions: Two CIM Planes per hemisphere/MXM, preserving baseline plane organization.

hemispheres.conditions: Full chip has four Planes; together with two Planes per hemisphere this means two hemispheres. The early section3.1 comparison of400Macros/hemisphere is not the finalized section3.2 topology; do not apply it to the final6400Macros/chip profile.

int32_writer_bpc.conditions: 256 B/cycle per transposed writer SuperLane per Plane. Section 3.4.6 permits distinct Core/Cluster results on distinct writer SuperLanes, not one serial Plane-wide writer. INT32 bypass service is an explicit model assumption; aggregate traffic remains constrained by MEM and directional streams. This does not multiply FP conversion-lane inventory. Runtime INT32 bypass is reported separately as an assumed service; this is not the Plane-wide FP conversion capacity.

streams_per_plane.conditions: 16 stream IDs allocated to each Plane within one direction/SuperLane; two Planes share the native32-ID budget.

lw_cores_per_cycle.conditions: Per SuperLane and Plane, two Cores/cycle*four Macros/Core*32B/wordline=256B/cycle distributed LW capture. Across20SL the width is5120B/cycle/Plane; this is not the256B/cycle individual transposed writer SuperLane service.

core_stagger_cycles.conditions: Adjacent Cores within a Cluster start one cycle apart, creating a five-cycle local staircase; project schedule target, not calibrated ASIC latency.

macro.description: Project K16xN32 INT8 Macro, four resident weight contexts. II is not first-result latency.

banks_per_context.conditions: 16 physical banks/context; bank corresponds to an N output position in native INT16 organization.

subarrays_per_bank.conditions: 16 sub-arrays/bank; sub-array corresponds to one K element.

columns_per_subarray.conditions: 16 bit columns/sub-array; physical columns do not change under INT8 splitting. Existing bit unit describes stored weight-bit width; this is also a count of 16 bit-columns.

weight_contexts.conditions: The finalized project design states 4 resident 512-byte contexts per Macro (2 KiB total); earlier section 3.1 calls four an adjustable example.

write_wordline_bytes.conditions: The L=16 write organization explicitly sets 32 bytes per Macro wordline; final LW schedule writes one wordline to each Macro in two Cores per Plane per SL. This is a documented project design choice, not silicon-verified write timing.

superlanes.conditions: 20 programmable SuperLanes; excludes unverified spare inventory.

hemispheres.conditions: Two mirrored hemispheres, each with two MXM planes.

planes_per_hemisphere.conditions: Two independent MXM planes per hemisphere; four per chip.

vxm_alus_per_lane.conditions: 16 ALUs per lane arranged as four groups of four; 20*16*16=5120 ALUs per chip. This is physical inventory, not task-effective throughput.

mem_slices_per_hemisphere.conditions: 44 MEM slices per hemisphere; 88 per chip.

mem_tiles_per_slice.conditions: Each MEM slice spans all 20 SuperLanes and has one local memory tile per SuperLane.

memory_tile_bytes.conditions: Each 16-lane memory tile has 128 KiB=131072 bytes total, including its two banks.

banks_per_memory_tile.conditions: Two banks per tile; read and write can overlap only when addressing different banks.

usable_mem_bytes.conditions: 2 hemispheres*44 slices*20 tiles*128 KiB=220 MiB=230686720 bytes of data MEM. Do not multiply again by bank count; not a full physical SRAM inventory.

sr_coordinates.conditions: SR0..SR44 are 45 positions along one complete SuperLane. They are not a route hop count and are not multiplied by hemispheres.

streams_per_direction.conditions: 32 stream IDs in each direction at an SR coordinate. Each SL carries its 16-byte portion using the same 32 IDs; do not multiply the ID count by 20.

stream_width_bytes.conditions: One stream has a 320-byte full-vector cross section across 20 SuperLanes; each local SL/SR contribution is 16 bytes. Execution is spatially staggered; 320 bytes is not the local per-SL writer width.

vxm_base_ops_per_cycle.source_version: vxm-algorithmic-reference-v1; 2026-11-18; original hardware context retained in source and retired parameter evidence
vxm_base_ops_per_cycle.conditions: Shared single-task VXM budget of 320 equivalent basic operations/cycle. With int32_add_cost=1 this preserves the prior 320 INT32 add/cycle service. Hemisphere scope denotes the active task allocation from the central VXM, not a replicated unit per hemisphere. All operation types share this budget; rates are alternatives, not additive. MEM/stream supply is charged separately. Fixed analytical assumption, not hardware calibration or the full 5120-ALU chip peak.

vxm_int32_add_cost.source_version: vxm-algorithmic-reference-v1; 2026-11-18; original hardware context retained in source and retired parameter evidence
vxm_int32_add_cost.conditions: One scalar-element INT32 addition consumes one equivalent operation on the shared single-task VXM service. Together with base=320 this preserves the existing GEMM cross-K add rate. No independent add resource is introduced.

vxm_fp32_basic_op_cost.source_version: vxm-algorithmic-reference-v1; 2026-11-18; original hardware context retained in source and retired parameter evidence
vxm_fp32_basic_op_cost.conditions: One scalar-element FP32 ADD or MUL consumes one equivalent operation on the shared VXM budget. Explicit new arithmetic-cost assumption, not measured parity with INT32. FMA, DIV, conversions, reductions and complete activation operators are not implicitly supported. Current GEMM does not execute FP32 operations.

vxm_fp32_exp_cost.source_version: vxm-algorithmic-reference-v1; 2026-11-18; original hardware context retained in source and retired parameter evidence
vxm_fp32_exp_cost.conditions: FP32 approximation work proxy: k=round(x*log2(e)), r=x-k*ln(2) costs 4; degree-5 Taylor polynomial in Horner form costs 5 MUL + 5 ADD; exponent scaling costs 1, total 15. Round and exponent scaling each count as one equivalent operation. No fused-operation discount. Reference domain is finite x in [-80,0]; no correctly-rounded FP32 or exceptional-value accuracy claim. This analytical service counts work only, does not evaluate exp numerically, and is not native TSP Exp instruction throughput or latency. Shares the VXM budget; memory and dependencies are separate.

vxm_fp32_rsqrt_cost.source_version: vxm-algorithmic-reference-v1; 2026-11-18; original hardware context retained in source and retired parameter evidence
vxm_fp32_rsqrt_cost.conditions: Positive-normal FP32 approximation work proxy: bit seed bits(y)=0x5f3759df-(bits(x)>>1) costs 2 (shift and subtraction; bit reinterpretation costs 0), then two iterations y=(0.5*y)*(3-x*y*y), each 4 MUL + 1 SUB, total 12. No fused-operation discount. No correctly-rounded FP32 or exceptional-value accuracy claim. This analytical service counts work only, does not evaluate rsqrt numerically, and is not native TSP RSqrt instruction throughput or latency. Shares the VXM budget; memory and dependencies are separate.

vxm_add_latency_cycles.source_version: vxm-algorithmic-reference-v1; 2026-11-18; original hardware context retained in source and retired parameter evidence
vxm_add_latency_cycles.conditions: Explicitly omit additional fixed INT32-add pipeline latency. Runtime first-row add time is ceil(actual padded tile N * vxm_int32_add_cost / vxm_base_ops_per_cycle) plus this value. This latency applies only to GEMM INT32 addition, not to FP32 special functions. Payload transport is charged separately. Zero is a model assumption, not measured zero hardware latency.

limitations: Static hemisphere waves, not asynchronous domain refill, chip execution or an ISA scheduler.
Shared bandwidth reservations are fluid analytical service, not individual stream slots or bank conflicts.
Independent MEM read/write services assume a conflict-free bank layout; all reads still share one read budget.
Row pipeline and distributed INT32 writers are explicit assumptions, not measured hardware timing.
K segments merge through MEM and one shared VXM service; no inter-Cluster PSUM link is invented.
MEM resident capacity is checked; collector capacity and exact rolling per-Core IW timing are not validated.
Known MEM plus Macro SRAM is a subtotal; energy, area and FP/BFP conversion are not evaluated.

execution_contract.source: Project analytical execution policy; ARCHITECTURE.md execution contract; ARCHITECTURE.md#tsp-mem-concurrency
execution_contract.version: 2026-11-18 independent MEM read/write services v1; background LW default
execution_contract.conditions: Explicit software modeling assumptions, not measured hardware behavior. Byte/cycle service budgets are allocated separately from chip inventory. CLI/API overrides are recorded in the effective execution contract. Fixed latencies use cycles; zero omits an uncalibrated allowance. Output-block/wave barriers and ideal input sharing remain declared approximations. MEM reads and writes use independent directional budgets under an assumed conflict-free bank layout. Activation, partial-sum and weight reads share the read budget. Bank placement, per-bank capacity and conflicts are not simulated; data dependencies and stream constraints still apply.

vxm_add_latency_cycles.conditions: Explicitly omit additional fixed INT32-add pipeline latency. Runtime first-row add time is ceil(actual padded tile N * vxm_int32_add_cost / vxm_base_ops_per_cycle) plus this value. This latency applies only to GEMM INT32 addition, not to FP32 special functions. Payload transport is charged separately. Zero is a model assumption, not measured zero hardware latency.

weight_buffer_bytes.source: Answer Fast (ASAP 2022), III-C; Hot Chips 34 Groq ISA slide 25; project finite-buffer approximation
weight_buffer_bytes.conditions: One pending INT8 weight block per hemisphere: 2 planes * 320 * 320 bytes = 204800 bytes (200 KiB). Buffer existence and overlapping weight preparation are documented; capacity is a modeling assumption, not a published SRAM size. Separate from resident A/B/C MEM allocation and not added to physical SRAM inventory. No extra LW capture-port limit beyond allocated MEM/stream service.

block_execution_profile.conditions: Single core/TensorCore/hemisphere. Native GEMM padding views share symbolic backing allocations. INT8 storage and FP32 nonlinear work; materialized outputs. No physical layout, quantization instruction or numerical accuracy claim.

to_fp32_cost.conditions: Coarse storage-boundary conversion work; no standalone instruction model.

to_int8_cost.conditions: Coarse scale/round/clamp work proxy; no numerical quantization or standalone instruction model.

fp32_rcp_cost.conditions: Reciprocal work proxy on the shared Vector/VXM budget.

ascend.conditions: HBM 与 UB 同时预约的 DMA 取两端最小服务率。输入 DMA、UB 操作数读取、计算、UB 结果写入、导出 DMA 分阶段串行，L2 bypass。每次算子调用为冷启动。 分块上限 1024 为确定性策略；显式零启动开销表示未建模固定延迟，不表示实测零延迟。无跨块重叠、广播、归约、转换或原地更新。

tpu.conditions: HBM 按 TensorCore 数均分，VMEM 为单核共享服务。输入 DMA、操作数读取、计算、结果写入、导出 DMA 分阶段串行；CMEM bypass。 分块上限 1024 为确定性策略；显式零启动开销表示未建模固定延迟，不表示实测零延迟。无跨块重叠、广播、归约、转换或原地更新。

tsp.conditions: 完整输入和输出驻留所选本侧 MEM。每个输入读取受 MEM 和输入 stream 共同约束；输出写回受 MEM 和输出 stream 共同约束。FP32/INT32 每元素 4 byte，stream 每块按完整宽度补齐，MEM 只计逻辑载荷。使用一个共享 VXM 任务预算，CIM 不复制预算。 分块上限 1024 为确定性策略；显式零启动开销表示未建模固定延迟，不表示实测零延迟。无跨块重叠、广播、归约、转换或原地更新。

ascend_ub_read_bpc.conditions: 每周期 64 个 32-bit 字作为独立 UB 端口服务代理：64*4=256 B/cycle。参考现有 Vector 预算量级选择，不是实测 UB 带宽；数值固定，不随 compute budget 修改。读写分阶段串行，DMA 同时预约 HBM 和 UB。

ascend_ub_write_bpc.conditions: 每周期 64 个 32-bit 字作为独立 UB 端口服务代理：64*4=256 B/cycle。参考现有 Vector 预算量级选择，不是实测 UB 带宽；数值固定，不随 compute budget 修改。读写分阶段串行，DMA 同时预约 HBM 和 UB。

composite.conditions: Last-axis FP32. Serial rows, passes and tiles. Balanced binary reduction levels wait for predecessors; partials merge into one row state. Constants are implicit; one scalar read per tile broadcasts without extra shuffle work. RMSNorm rereads x and loads weight per row. Softmax stores exp in the output allocation, then normalizes it. No numerical accuracy or hardware-instruction claims.

fp32_sub_cost.conditions: One scalar SUB modeled as one basic equivalent operation; shares native Vector/VXM budget, not calibrated.

fp32_max_cost.conditions: One pairwise MAX comparison/selection modeled as one equivalent operation; not calibrated.

fp32_rcp_cost.conditions: Algorithmic proxy: one seed-equivalent operation plus two Newton-style updates of two MUL and one SUB each: 1+2*3=7. Seed accuracy and numerical result are not modeled; not native reciprocal timing.

reduction_round_cycles.conditions: Minimum compute dependency interval per tree level or cross-tile binary merge. Total compute is max(weighted-work cycles, this value); memory and startup charged separately. Not a measured shuffle or lane-network latency.

limitations: One core/TensorCore/hemisphere; no chip partition, communication or inter-node overlap.
All nodes materialize outputs; native GEMM cold-cache policies retained; no extra edge-transfer charge.
Symbolic padded views share one allocation per tensor; layout conversion instructions are not modeled.
INT8 boundaries use explicit uncalibrated work proxies, without scales, saturation values or numerical accuracy claims.
Inputs persist; intermediate storage releases after its last consumer. Local buffers are reused between nodes.
Head/matrix shapes are symbolic views of the same backing; physical packing requires layout validation, with no standalone reshape/transpose model.

io_contract.name_scope: Within one operator call; graph callers must qualify names by node identity.
io_contract.intermediate_residency: No UB/VMEM/register retention across operator calls is promised.
io_contract.conversion: No implicit cast, dequantization or requantization; stored dtype is binding.
io_contract.traffic: Standalone actions already include each block's boundary accesses; connections do not remove them.
